description: From DWSIM Expander.vb -- DWSIM's turbine/expander model, basis for tampines::components::Turbine (op-dt3.4). Isentropic (PS-flash) ideal outlet state, adiabatic-efficiency-corrected real outlet, iterative Schultz polytropic-efficiency correction factor (ASME PTC-10-style, mutual dependence between polytropic/adiabatic efficiency resolved by fixed-point iteration). Skip Curves mode (Floater-Hormann rational interpolation) for now -- separate deferred bead.
title: Port expander/turbine isentropic + Schultz polytropic model
